officialSources.observation: Official Dujiangyan government-service document lists approval for organizations using classified foundational surveying成果 and names the Dujiangyan Planning and Natural Resources Bureau. This evidences local natural-resources custody, not an open parcel-vector service.
Official Chengdu public-data portal exposes geographic-space and district/county catalogs, but the bounded review did not verify a Dujiangyan parcel dataset or geometry API.

Ministry of Natural Resources Real Estate Registration Center site provides national registration context and links to local registration websites; it did not expose Dujiangyan parcel geometry in the bounded review.

China Geological Survey report describes Tianditu as the national public geographic-information service platform and its public-service role; it is general national platform context, not evidence of Dujiangyan cadastral polygons.
